# DISCIPLE

> Multiplayer memecoins and 1v1 trading duels. Launch your own coin with a crew, or take on another trader for one minute.

DISCIPLE is a game on top of real memecoins. Every coin is a rocket: players buy in to boost it up, sell to cash out, and anyone can bomb it down.

## Modes

- Launch: launch your own coin and fly it with your crew.
- Duel: 1v1 trading duel. One minute, best PnL wins. Each player trades their own position and keeps their own PnL.
- Climb: solo trading levels.
- Daily mission: one run a day, the same for everyone, with a daily board.
